children: Nordic markets are seen opening little-changed with IG calling the OMXS30 flat at around 3307. Brent crude oil fell back toward $100 yesterday on hopes of diplomatic progress between the U.S. and Iran in connection with today's UN meeting in New York, where President Trump will speak, SEB economist Pia Fromlet writes. Yields on government bonds fell as a result of lower oil prices. The fall in oil prices and lower yields bolstered risk appetite and stock markets rose in general, driven by technology stocks, Fromlet adds. Japanese markets are closed today but other Asian stock markets are rising, while stock market futures indicate positive openings in the U.S. and Europe. OMXS30 closed at 3307.02, OMXN40 at 2657.68 and OBX at 2023.59. (dominic.chopping@wsj.com)
